info.title: Cadence API
info.description: Personal weekly Kanban API for Cadence: board, tasks, imports, notifications, archive, and analytics with CSV/XLSX/PDF export jobs.

get.description:
OpenApi3 schema for this API. Format can be selected via content negotiation.

- YAML: application/vnd.oai.openapi
- JSON: application/vnd.oai.openapi+json

200.description: CSV, XLSX, or PDF file attachment.

409.description: Export is not ready for download.

get.description: Returns tabular sheet data for the export dialog. Layout matches styled XLSX and PDF exports.

ExportTypeEnum.description:
* `tasks` - Tasks
* `archive` - Archive
* `weekly_summary` - Weekly summary
* `tag_summary` - Tag summary
* `notification_report` - Notification report
* `jobs_report` - Jobs report
* `imports_report` - Imports report
